assignments.node_id: ראו האמת, והשליכו החכמות, והאמינו בה ובמשה עבדו
assignments.reason: This node describes Israel's threefold act — seeing truth, casting away external wisdoms, and believing in God and Moses. Its essential nature is the positive embrace of simplicity and faith over philosophical speculation, which is precisely what Package 1 encodes: the identity of naval (seeming foolishness) with Torah (true divine wisdom). Casting away wisdoms and believing IS the lived expression of the naval-Torah equation.

Receiving the Torah is the direct outcome whose essential nature is Torah itself — the dominant node of Package 1. The act of receiving Torah belongs to the same thematic domain of divine wisdom/Torah that defines this package.

Casting away all external wisdoms is the practical prerequisite whose essential nature aligns with the naval-Torah identity: the Rebbe teaches that 'naval' (not-wise) IS Torah, because true wisdom requires nullifying false wisdoms. This act of discarding is the behavioral face of the same reality that Package 1 encodes — choosing divine simplicity (Torah) over human philosophical wisdom.

The receiving of Torah (noun form) shares the same essential nature as קבלו התורה (verb form) — both denote Torah-reception, the central outcome of the teaching. Its nature is Torah itself, the dominant node of Package 1.
